decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. The deck is built around a combination of cheap spells like Lightning Axe and Opt to not only fuel the Phoenix but also draw cards with Treasure Cruise. Demilich serves as another way to recur spells and maintain pressure on the opponent. Picklock Prankster adds a disruptive element to the deck, while Artist's Talent provides additional card draw. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and evasive threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature play and disruption through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. It aims to control the board and deal damage quickly with efficient creatures like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opponent's threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around applying pressure early in the game while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck is focused on quickly getting Arclight Phoenix into play and using spells like Lightning Axe, Fiery Impulse, and Picklock Prankster to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. With cards like Treasure Cruise and Consider to draw more cards and efficient spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand to find what you need, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and card advantage. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Proft's Eidetic Memory adds extra power and versatility to the deck's game plan.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse, and board wipes like Nowhere to Run. It also aims to generate card advantage with cards like Treacherous Blessing and Yorion, Sky Nomad, while also applying pressure with threats like Legion's Landing and Hopeless Nightmare. The deck utilizes a variety of lands to ensure it has the right colors of mana available at all times to control the game and outvalue the opponent.

The main strategy of this Dimir Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence with low-cost evasive creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Spyglass Siren, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce. Kaito, Bane of Nightmares serves as a powerful finisher that can quickly close out the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's moves through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful enchantments. It aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage and utilizing synergies between its cards. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value by flickering permanents. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck seeks to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy while establishing its own game plan.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with cheap and efficient creatures such as Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary. Cards like Atarka's Command and Monstrous Rage help enhance the damage output and provide reach to close out games quickly. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offense, utilizing the synergy between creatures and combat tricks to secure victory.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on creating a strong board presence with low-cost creatures while also gaining life through a variety of cards. The key strategy is to quickly flood the board with creatures like Bishop of Wings and Youthful Valkyrie, while also utilizing cards like Giada, Font of Hope and Righteous Valkyrie to benefit from gaining life. Collected Company helps to quickly find and put more creatures on the field, while cards like Skyclave Apparition provide removal options. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and life gain.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources through various spells and abilities, while also taking advantage of card advantage and card selection with Narset, Parter of Veils and other cards. It aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant board presence with powerful finishers like The Meathook Massacre and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck also includes a variety of utility lands to help fix mana and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to play creatures that can deal direct damage, along with spells that can clear the way for them to attack. The deck also includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to provide additional value. With a mix of creatures and spells designed to deal damage efficiently, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

Use a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful enchantments to stabilize the board and outvalue the opponent. Focus on controlling the game until you can overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and powerful threats like Legion's Landing and Nurturing Pixie. This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to control the board by sacrificing creatures to search for powerful enchantments. The deck includes a variety of Overlord creatures and Leyline Binding to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a focus on synergy and resource management, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and maintain control of the game through a combination of card advantage and strategic plays. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in longer games.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. By utilizing creatures with abilities that pump up their power, along with direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and force them to react defensively. The inclusion of land cards that can also deal damage, such as Ramunap Ruins and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance, adds an extra layer of aggression to the deck.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and dealing quick damage to the opponent. The key concept is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Heartfire Hero, as well as pump spells like Infuriate. The deck also utilizes cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Monstrous Rage to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mix of direct damage, creature aggression, and pump effects, this deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressively deploying threats and disrupting your opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Duress. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in combat. The mana base includes efficient lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Mutavault to ensure smooth gameplay and consistent aggression.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence using mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while also having access to powerful cards like Collected Company and Skyclave Apparition for additional value and removal. By maintaining pressure and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck can quickly close out games and secure victories in a fast-paced environment like Pioneer 1 vs 1.
